quarterly_data.signal: Board approved (May 8, 2026) an increase of NT$11 hundred million (NT$11 yi as filed) to the capital expenditure budget for its copper foil Plant No. 3, funded by bank loans and own funds, to raise capacity and process capability for high-end copper foil in response to AI server market demand

Co-Tech Development.why: Electrolytic copper foil is 100% of revenue; its HVLP3/HVLP4 foil goes into the high-speed CCL and high-layer-count PCBs of AI servers (NVIDIA Blackwell / Rubin and CSP ASIC platforms), so AI-server board volumes drive its sales
